text:
ria: Flagging Thespian's LoRA bring-up (cust-thespian). Quick smoke with int4-pack-B shows surprising insertion of a locale tag token mid-response — looks like a tokenmap offset after merge. cc @omar @devon

omar: Can you paste the failing example? Might be an embed-dtype mismatch during merge.

ria: Example thread (truncated):
User: Give me a step-by-step for setting up delivery windows for a grocery app.
Assistant (fp16 merged): ... Step 3: set timezone to PST. Step 4: configure windows ...
Assistant (int4 merged): ... Step 3: <LOC:es> Step 4: configure windows ...

devon: Hmm that <LOC:es> looks like an inserted special token. Did the adapter add a locale token to its vocab? Merge should remap, but maybe we missed reserve slots.

ria: Eval quick summary: instruction suite pass rate 85/90, conv suite pass 47/50, regressions 3/5 failing (localized-insert, long-instruct-cut). Metrics: BLEU_fp16 0.712 -> int4 0.675, avg_len -11%.

ci-bot: /ci/9120: model-merge-smoke triggered by @ria. 3 failing checks: localized-insert, long-instruct-cut, rerank-sensitivity. Logs: /ci/9120/logs.

omar: Quick triage I ran: tokenizer.compare(base, merged, adapter) shows an extra token id 50265 present only after merge at positions where locale tags are expected. Looks like adapter tokenizer used reserved id at 50265.

casey: Could be because adapter fine-tune added a custom token mapping for their shorthand markers. We should re-run tokenizer.build_map with keep_reserved=true and then remap before merging.

ria: Repro steps I used:
```bash
# quickpack run
python -m rwi.eval --customer thespian --adapter thespian-lora-v1 \ 
  --merge stitch --quant int4-pack-B --suites instruction,conv,regress --seed 7
# output: bleu:0.675 rouge-l:0.604 avg_resp_len:128
```

omar: Also tried soft-merge (no vocab touch): insertion persists. Suggests merge remap logic is defaulting to append vs remap into reserved slot.

devon: Plan: 1) regenerate tokenizer mapping with adapter tokens normalized (keep_reserved), 2) run merge with --force-remap, 3) run int8-pack verification to see if packing changes alignment, 4) run prefix-only inference to rule out KV-cache mismatch.

ria: I'll push a reproducer script and the failing prompts to /shared/evals/thespian/fails.tar.gz.

ci-bot: /ci/9121: started remap verification sweep (force-remap=yes/no) triggered by @omar.

casey: Ops note: if remap fixes it, we'll need to coordinate a patch to the merge service to default to force-remap for adapters that introduce new tokens. I'll draft a short RFC.

omar: token-diff snippet (from token-diff tool):
```
BASE TOKENS: [1, 12, 77, 890, 44, ...]
ADAPTER TOKENS (pre-merge): [1, 12, 77, 890, 44, ...]
MERGED TOKENS (post-merge): [1, 12, 77, 890, 44, 50265, 99, ...]
# extra token inserted at pos 6
```

devon: Good catch. If merge inserts token id 50265, that shifts subsequent token positions and could shorten generations if stop-token logic is position-sensitive in our comparator.

ria: CI sweep results: remap=yes -> localized-insert fixed, long-instruct flaky; remap=no -> fails. Full table: /ci/9121/results.csv

ci-bot: /ci/9121: PASSED remap=yes (9/10), remap=no (7/10). See /ci/9121/summary.

casey: Next steps: deploy remap patch to canary merge-service, re-run int4-pack-B smoke, and if stable, enable canary roll for Thespian on dedicated pool with opt-in.

ops-bot: Canary config prepared at /ops/canaries/thespian-remap-v1.json. Ready for manual approval.

ria: Agreed. I'll validate a larger holdout overnight. If we still see long-instruct-cut we may need to try int8 pack or increase adapter-rescale to 0.65 as a mitigation.

omar: I'll open GH issue with traces + tokenizer mapping: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/4623. Attaching diffs and the reproducer.

devon: If anyone wants to pair-debug KV-cache after remap, I'm free in 30. Could be an unrelated packing corner-case.

ria: Thanks all. Will post final after nightly holdout. :white_check_mark:
